structured_output.content: The release note (ev-7be235e771a3) only says that cert-manager v1.18.0 adds support for the ACME profiles extension. It does not say whether the feature is opt-in, which resource or field turns it on, or whether existing ACME issuance changes. The environment summary shows Certificate resources (cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate) and only one installed CRD, certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. It does not show any Issuer or ClusterIssuer, any ACME configuration, or any values key related to ACME, so I can't tell whether these Certificates are issued through ACME at all. To settle this, check whether your issuers use ACME and read PR #7777 to see how the profiles feature is turned on and whether it changes anything for existing ACME issuers.
